title: Top 7 public companies in this window
ranking_method_plain: Public companies only (verified ticker). Ranked by sourced federal dollars in the Jun 3–Sep 1 2026 window, with status weights: FINAL or paid cash counts at 1.00; CONDITIONAL at 0.40; letter of intent (LOI) at 0.15; undefinitized contract action (UCA) obligated cash at 1.00 and UCA face/ceiling at 0.05 because face is not cash; loan facilities at 0.40 even when tagged FINAL. Duplicate Centrus rows in curated.json and awards.json are counted once.
disclaimer: This is a federal-money screen, not a buy list, not investment advice. Past awards do not mean the stock will go up. We do not invent growth percentages, price targets, or forecasts. Rank is not a prediction of returns.
note: We did not pad to 20. Verified public tickers in this window: LMT, RTX, LEU, USAR, PCG, GFS from data/curated.json, plus ABB from data/awards.json. A USAspending keyword pull also showed small NIST CHIPS lab buys to other listed names (for example IPG Photonics, MKS, Teledyne LeCroy); those are equipment purchases, consistent with CAMECA remaining public:false in awards.json, so they are not ranked. MP, IBM, OKLO, IONQ, BWXT on companies.html are previously reported, not in-window awards.
